DevopsTestSuiteExecution.name: DevopsTestSuiteExecution
DevopsTestSuiteExecution.description: Records the individual execution lifecycle, results, and metrics of a specific test suite within a DevOps pipeline stage. It tracks granular outcomes like code coverage, pass/fail rates, and links directly back to the overarching test suite group.

Coverage.description: The automated code coverage percentage for example, Apex test coverage, achieved during this specific test suite execution.

DevopsTestSuiteGroupExecId.description: References the parent DevopsTestSuiteGroupExec record that coordinates this and other related test suite executions within the pipeline stage.

DevopsTestSuiteId.description: References the definition of the DevopsTestSuite being executed.

DevopsTestSuiteStageId.description: References the specific stage configuration or environment step (DevopsTestSuiteStage) where this execution takes place.

ExecutionEndTime.description: The date and time when the test suite finished executing. This field remains null while the execution is actively InProgress.

ExecutionStartTime.description: The precise date and time when the execution of this test suite commenced.

ExternalIdRef.description: A unique identifier used to map or reference this test run to an external CI/CD engine, testing framework, or third-party tool execution ID.

FailureCount.description: The total number of individual test cases or assertions that failed during this test suite run.

FailureRate.description: The calculated percentage of failed tests relative to the total number of tests run in this suite.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, such as through a related list or lookup context.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last explicitly viewed this record's detail page or list view.

LearnMore.description: A URL pointing to supplemental documentation, internal run logs, or troubleshooting guides relevant to this test suite execution.

Name.description: A system-generated unique auto-number identifier assigned to the test suite execution record.

OwnerId.description: Identifies the user or queue that owns this specific test suite execution record.

QualityGateStatus.description: Represents the final evaluation outcome of any automated quality policies or compliance criteria established for this test suite.

ReportUrl.description: The web link to the complete, detailed test execution report or artifacts (e.g., JUnit XML, HTML dashboard) generated by the runner.

ResultDetails.description: A raw block of summary text, error logs, stack traces, or console output detailing why a test failed or stalled.

Status.description: The operational state of the test suite run execution process itself.

SuccessCount.description: The total number of individual test cases or assertions that completed successfully without errors.

SuccessRate.description: The calculated percentage of passing tests relative to the total number of tests run in this suite.
